title: BladeRunner: a compact 3D-printed blade-coating stage for in situ thin-film deposition (firmware, GUI, CAD/STL, documentation)
description: This repository accompanies the manuscript "Democratizing Lab Automation through Multi-Agent-Assisted Design and 3D Printing" (Hwang et al., submitted to Digital Discovery, 2026). BladeRunner is a low-cost, Arduino-controlled lead-screw linear stage that fits inside a stereomicroscope bay for in situ meniscus-guided coating. The repository contains the Arduino firmware, the Python/Tkinter host GUI and its standalone build configuration, STL files for all printed parts, the bill of materials, and assembly and implementation guides.
notes: Code, design files and documentation released with the manuscript; see the repository README for build and usage instructions.
